DESI SATURDAYS: IT'S A BOLLYWOOD THING 🪩
Boston, it’s time to live out your main character moment. ✨ We are bringing the ultimate Bollywood Night to the city featuring the world-famous DJ Dharak!
No boring loops—just non-stop, high-energy Bollywood club remixes, iconic 2000s throwbacks, and heavy electronic flips that will have you screaming the lyrics all night.

📍 THE VENUE
Academy Boston
33 Dunster St, Cambridge MA

🔊 THE INSIDE SCOOP
The Lineup: World Famous DJ Dharak spinning live! 🎬The Sound: Unhinged Bollywood anthems + heavy bass diaspora edits.The Vibe: Pure energy, crowd sing-alongs, and an immaculate crowd.The Look: Smart casual / Club-chic. Dress like you're in a music video.
🥂 VIP TABLES
Want bottle service for your crew? DM us on IG @desisaturdays to lock down a VIP table.

⚠️ THE FINE PRINT
Spots will fill up fast! RSVP below to secure your place on the guestlist.21+ only (Physical ID required at the door).
Grab your friends, warm up your vocal cords, and let’s make it a movie. 🍾🍿
